hero.title:
The free pager
that rings their phone.
hero.subtitle: $t(pager.brand.name) replaces plastic restaurant pagers with the phone your customer already carries. One QR on the counter, and their phone rings when the order is ready. Free for your venue.
hero.note: No app, no account, nothing to buy.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: The customer scans and waits. Nothing to install, nothing to type.

steps.title: Scan the QR at the counter
steps.body: One printed QR code sits by the till. The customer points their camera at it and the page opens. No app to download, no account to create.

steps.title: Show the code to the cashier
steps.body: Their phone shows a short code. The cashier types the order number or their name on that code, and they sit down, step outside or carry on with their day.

steps.title: Their phone rings when it is ready
steps.body: When the order is up, your staff tap Ready on the board and the customer's phone rings.

compare.title: Everything a plastic pager does, without the plastic
compare.intro: The customer's phone does the job the buzzer did, so everything the buzzer cost you goes away.

items.title: Nothing to buy
items.body: No set of pagers and no spare parts. The customer brings the device.

items.title: Nothing to charge
items.body: No charging base on the counter and no flat pager in the middle of the rush.

items.title: Nothing to clean
items.body: No device passing from hand to hand all day, so nothing to wipe down between customers.

items.title: Nothing to lose
items.body: No pagers leaving in a pocket or a bag.

free.title: Why is it free?
free.body: rtylr makes a point of sale system. $t(pager.brand.name) is free because we want restaurant owners to see how we build things, with something they can use at their counter today.

closing.title: Hear it ring for yourself
closing.subtitle: Try the staff board and the customer's phone side by side, right in your browser. No signup needed.

landing.footer: A free pager for restaurants and cafés.
